similar_in_english: have a hide like a rhinoceros
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খোসা পুরু, কোনো লজ্জা বোধ করে না।
এই খোসা পুরু লোকের সাথে কথা বলা বৃথা।
example_sentences_in_english: He is thick-skinned and feels no shame.
It's pointless talking to this shameless person with thick skin.
history: References to English people (খোসাপুরু জাত) described as thick-skinned, possibly from colonial-era observations by figures like Pratham Chaudhuri.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of thick outer skin, akin to animal hides, symbolizing emotional imperviousness in Bengali folklore and literature.
